mechanic.summary: At full energy Kokia targets a location with a large impact and summons a Blazebound Firestorm.
mechanic.response: Place the add close enough for efficient swapping without overlapping the group, then kill it before repeated casts overwhelm the party.

provenance.description: Current Season 2 tactical classification from Wowhead's Patch 12.1 Ruby Life Pools guide and linked spell record.
